request_payload.title: Occurrence of Infusion Associated Reactions and Antidrug Antibodies in Enzyme Replacement Therapy for Fabry Disease and the Effect of Preventive Measures.

mentions.sentence: Male patients with the classical phenotype of Fabry disease (FD) are at risk of developing inhibiting antidrug antibodies (iADAs) against recombinant α-galactosidase-A, administered in the form of enzyme replacement therapy (ERT).

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Fabry disease (agalsidase beta, pegunigalsidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of alpha-galactosidase A for people with Fabry disease.

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Pompe disease (alglucosidase alfa, avalglucosidase alfa, cipaglucosidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of acid alpha-glucosidase, the only disease-specific treatment class for Pompe disease.
